core_obligations: Show alpha circ beta = [Z x_Y W / X / S]_{r+e} for Z flat over Y (proof lines 2879-2882). This is a special case of lemma-construction-coherent (tag 0H69) with F = O_Z and G = O_W: the closed subscheme families [Z/X/Y]_r and [W/Y/S]_e are the module families of O_Z and O_W (example-family-associated-closed, tag 0H4S), O_Z is flat over Y by hypothesis, and the tensor O_Z tensor_{O_X} f^* O_W is the structure sheaf of Z x_Y W, so the coherent identity gives the claimed fibred product family (proof lines 2879-2881).
proof_roadmap: View the closed subscheme families as module families of the structure sheaves (statement line 2875, example tag 0H4S).
Apply the coherent construction lemma with F = O_Z, G = O_W and identify the tensor with the structure sheaf of the fibred product (proof lines 2879-2881).
